cases.name: mixed-portfolio-backlog
cases.task: Audit the whole site. The graph report shows two broken internal destinations, six orphan glossary pages, four dead ends, and low PageRank on a strategic AI governance article. GEO validation also reports missing sources on three posts. Produce the remediation order and specialist handoffs.
assertions: Broken destinations are prioritized before orphans, dead ends, GEO remediation, and authority optimization.
Orphans and dead ends route to content-interlinking; technical path failures route to technical-seo; source and GEO failures route to geo-optimization.
The authority opportunity is deferred until higher-priority structural findings are resolved or explicitly blocked.
The report includes comparable before-and-after values from scripts/seo/graph_analyzer.ts and npm run validate:geo for the same scope.

cases.name: pagerank-editorial-conflict
cases.task: The highest-PageRank glossary page is unrelated to a low-authority article, but linking them would improve the article's graph score. A moderately authoritative related article could link naturally. Choose the portfolio action.
assertions: The unrelated high-PageRank link is rejected despite its metric benefit.
The contextually relevant link is routed to content-interlinking with descriptive anchor and placement constraints.
The decision states that PageRank is diagnostic evidence rather than the editorial objective.
No sitewide, footer, or repetitive exact-match link tactic is proposed.

cases.name: intentional-terminal-page
cases.task: The graph analyzer flags a legal confirmation page as a dead end and a noindex campaign archive as an orphan. Decide whether they should enter the SEO remediation backlog.
assertions: Each finding is classified before remediation rather than automatically linked.
The intentional terminal journey may be accepted with a documented rationale.
The noindex archive is not treated as an indexable orphan without verifying its intended status.
Any status, robots, canonical, or indexation uncertainty routes to technical-seo.

cases.name: single-page-specialist-non-trigger
cases.task: Add a missing canonical tag to one known page and verify it.
assertions: The seo-mastery portfolio orchestrator is not invoked for this single known technical fix.
The task routes directly to technical-seo without running a portfolio-wide authority program.
Verification checks the rendered canonical URL for the page and confirms that it is singular and correct.
